name: BINANA
summary: Geometric characterization of protein-small molecule contacts from prepared receptor and ligand poses.

steps: Select the maintainer's BINANA v2.1 release and its Python-library asset binanapy.zip; do not confuse it with the web-app or JavaScript assets.

Download the release into a user-owned directory, record its source URL and SHA-256, and inspect archive paths before extracting. GitHub release metadata does not currently publish an asset digest, so no fixed digest is asserted here.
Use the maintainer's python/COMMAND_LINE_USE.md instructions to run the included run_binana.py in a suitable Python environment; keep receptor and ligand PDBQT/PDB inputs separate and prepared.
If Python dependencies or command locations differ from the pinned release instructions, stop and review them rather than installing guessed packages globally.
install.verify_note: Run the included command-line script's documented basic usage on a small public receptor-ligand example and record the Python interpreter, script path, release tag and observed archive digest.

notes: BINANA v2.1 is offered as an official release archive, not a reviewed PyPI/conda package in this catalog. Contact classification depends on prepared structures and geometric definitions; installation alone does not validate interaction calls.
